title: Probe Fabro sandbox devenv nesting and format permissions

goal.value: Probe Fabro sandbox devenv nesting and format permissions

script.String:
set -eux
pwd
id
echo PATH=$PATH
ls -ld . web web/test web/test/memba/messaging || true
PROBE=web/test/memba/messaging/fabro_format_probe_test.exs
cat > $PROBE <<'EOT'
defmodule FabroFormatProbeTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "probe" do
    assert true
  end
end
EOT
ls -l $PROBE
echo '== direct bin/mix format on current-owned file =='
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" bin/mix format $PROBE
ls -l $PROBE
cat > $PROBE <<'EOT'
defmodule FabroFormatProbeTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "probe" do
    assert true
  end
end
EOT
if chown root:root $PROBE 2>/tmp/chown.err; then echo chown_root_ok; else echo chown_root_failed; cat /tmp/chown.err; fi
chmod 0644 $PROBE || true
ls -l $PROBE
echo '== direct bin/mix format on root-owned file =='
if PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" bin/mix format $PROBE; then echo direct_root_owned_ok; else echo direct_root_owned_failed; fi
ls -l $PROBE
cat > $PROBE <<'EOT'
defmodule FabroFormatProbeTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "probe" do
    assert true
  end
end
EOT
chown root:root $PROBE 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 0644 $PROBE || true
ls -l $PROBE
echo '== nested devenv shell mix format on root-owned file =='
if devenv shell -- sh -lc 'pwd; id; mix format web/test/memba/messaging/fabro_format_probe_test.exs'; then echo nested_root_owned_ok; else echo nested_root_owned_failed; fi
ls -l $PROBE
rm -f $PROBE
